note: quince#202 constraint 2, the direction that is NOT a wake. Red to green is good news and still not an interruption: the ruling is wake on SUCCESS -> FAILURE ONLY, because a recovery resolves the thing that already woke somebody, and waking a second session to say the problem is over turns every red into two interruptions. The event is still EMITTED and printed — `wake_worthy` drops it, this classifier does not, which is the same seen-versus-woken split every other family here follows. Without this fixture a build that woke on every trunk transition would pass the red one and nothing would notice.
